ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( /* Exclude Record Types */ NOT( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "DairyWorkerLicence", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSBCCDCDairyPlantLicence" ) ), NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), NOT(ISBLANK(LicenseTypeId)),
Account.RecordTypeName__c = "Facility", TEXT(Account.Type) = "Sewerage",
NOT( OR( /* Sewerage Holding Tank Permit to Construct */ AND( TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) = "Holding tank",
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "ConstructionPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions" ),
LicenseType.Name = "Sewerage Holding Tank Permit to Construct" ),
/* Record of Sewerage System */ AND( OR( TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) = "Sewerage system - Type 1", TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) = "Sewerage system - Type 2", TEXT(Account.CategoryL1__c) = "Sewerage system - Type 3" ),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRecordofSewerageSystem", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions" ),
LicenseType.Name = "Record of Sewerage System" ) ) ) )
